note: Drafted, not run. No with-skill or baseline run exists for these tasks. [script] assertions use scripts/py_audit.py, python checks or plain string checks; [judge] assertions need a blind grader. The audit script is the skill's own tool, so at least one judge assertion per task measures something it does not control.

evals.prompt: Modernise report_tool.py for Python 3.12 the way a senior reviewer would expect. Keep its behaviour (read every .json file in a folder, summarise amounts). Save the result as report_tool_new.py and tell me what you changed.
assertions: [script] report_tool_new.py has no occurrence of 'List[' or 'Optional[' (grep)
[script] every open or read_text call in report_tool_new.py passes encoding= (grep count equals call count)
[judge] The bare except is replaced by named exceptions (OSError and json.JSONDecodeError or narrower), and the failure is logged with traceback or re-raised, not silently dropped
[judge] The reply ends with the fixed report (Target, Changed, Audit, Project checks, Decisions, Not checked) and says which checks were not run

evals.prompt: resize_and_fetch.py downloads 40 images and hashes each one; the hashing loop is pure Python and slow. It is not using the cores. Fix it and explain the concurrency choice. Save as resize_and_fetch_new.py.
assertions: [script] the file contains a main guard (if __name__ == with double or single quotes)
[script] the file passes a timeout= argument to the network call
[judge] Downloads and hashing are treated as different workloads: threads or asyncio for the downloads, processes for the hashing, or processes for both with the reason stated
[judge] The explanation says why threads do not speed up the pure Python hashing, and names the main guard as required for process pools on Windows and macOS

evals.prompt: Move this little package to a modern packaging setup and add a first pytest file for slugify. Remove what is no longer needed. Dev tools must not become runtime dependencies.
assertions: [script] pyproject.toml exists, parses with tomllib, and project.requires-python starts with '>=3.11' or later
[script] pytest and black do not appear under project.dependencies
[script] a tests/test_*.py file exists and uses pytest.mark.parametrize
[judge] The unidecode dependency has a lower-bound range rather than an exact pin, or the reply explains why it was kept exact; no new runtime dependency was added
